headline: Executive order closed federal government departments and agencies for one day on April 27, 1994.
what_it_does: This order closed executive branch departments and agencies of the federal government on Wednesday, April 27, 1994. The title does not give the reason for the closing, and no summary was provided. Details such as exceptions for essential work are not described in the available information.

who_it_affects.how: Most were likely given the day off from work on April 27, 1994, because their offices were closed.

who_it_affects.group: People who needed in-person federal services that day
who_it_affects.how: Federal offices covered by the order were closed on April 27, 1994.
